collection.title: Citroen Dispatch 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen Dispatch MPV 2016 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Citroen Dispatch 2016 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
